onboarding.welcomeIntro: Termix hanterar dina servrar från ett ställe. Installationen tar ungefär en minut och ingenting här är permanent.

onboarding.done_rerun: Vill du ha det här igen?

onboarding.done_desktop_desc: Termix körs som en skrivbordsapp på Windows, macOS och Linux.
onboarding.done_mobile_desc: Ta med dig dina servrar på iOS och Android.
onboarding.done_docs_desc: Guider för varje funktion, inklusive de som inte tas upp här.
onboarding.done_cli_desc: Hantera dina servrar från en terminal och använd Termix i dina egna skript.

donation.title: Gillar du Termix?
donation.body: Termix är gratis och öppen källkod, byggt och underhållet av ett team på två personer på vår fritid. Om det ersätter ett kommersiellt verktyg som du annars skulle betala för, hjälper en donation till att täcka hostingkostnader och hålla utvecklingen igång. För närvarande är donationer endast kryptovalutor.
donation.milestones: Donationer hjälper också till att finansiera tiden som krävs för att undersöka och lära sig vad som behövs för att bygga funktioner som SAML och Kubernetes-stöd. Se framstegen på donationssidan.

userProfile.donateDescription: Termix är gratis, självhostat och byggt av endast ett fåtal personer på sin fritid. Om det har sparat dig tid eller pengar, hjälper en kryptodonation till att hålla det igång.
userProfile.donateMilestones: Donationer hjälper till att finansiera tiden för att undersöka och lära sig vad som behövs för att bygga stöd för SAML, Kubernetes och agenter. Se framstegen och donera.
userProfile.storageModeDescription: Webbläsaren lagrar inställningar endast i den här webbläsaren. Databasen synkroniseras med servern och laddas på valfri enhet.
userProfile.desktopProfileDescription: This profile lives on this device and signs in by itself. Link it to a Termix server to use the same hosts and settings on every device.
userProfile.interfacePresetDesc: Hur mycket detaljer Termix visar. Alla funktioner förblir tillgängliga.
userProfile.presetConfirmDesc: Detta återställer sidofältet, navigeringen, instrumentpanelens layout, terminalverktygsfältet och filhanterarvyn. Dina värdar, inloggningsuppgifter och startsida påverkas inte.
userProfile.runSetupAgainDesc: Gå igenom den första körningens installation igen.
userProfile.betaProgramDescription: Testa kommande funktioner tidigt med den veckovisa rullande :beta Docker-taggen. Instabil, inte för produktion.
userProfile.betaProgramFeedback: Hittat ett fel? Rapportera det här.
userProfile.cliDescription: Öppna terminaler, kör kommandon och flytta filer från ditt eget skal.
userProfile.deleteAccountPermanent: Denna åtgärd är permanent och kan inte ångras.
userProfile.deleteAccountWarning: Alla sessioner, värdar, inloggningsuppgifter och inställningar kommer att raderas permanent.
userProfile.confirmPasswordDeletePlaceholder: Ange ditt lösenord för att bekräfta
userProfile.interfaceFontDescription: Ändrar teckensnittet i programgränssnittet. Terminalprofiler behåller sina egna teckensnittsinställningar.
userProfile.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Anpassa kortkommandon för terminalkopiering, klistra in och kommandon
userProfile.reopenTabsOnLoginDesc: Återställ dina öppna flikar när du loggar in eller uppdaterar sidan, även från en annan enhet
userProfile.showTabNumbersDesc: Display a number on each tab to help tell them apart
userProfile.sidebarSettingsMoved: Visningsinställningarna för värds sidofält har flyttats till panelen Anpassa sidofältet, som öppnas från verktygsfältet Värdar.
userProfile.hostTrayOnClickDesc: Visa alltid anslutningsknappar; klicka för att expandera hanteringsalternativ istället för att hålla muspekaren över
userProfile.compactHostViewDesc: Minimera varje värd till en enda rad som endast visar dess namn och adress
userProfile.statusColorsDesc: Använd grönt/rött för online-/offline-status istället för accentfärgen
userProfile.pinAppRailDesc: Håll applist i vänster sidofält alltid expanderad istället för att expandera när du håller muspekaren över den
userProfile.expandAppRailOnHoverDesc: Tillåt att den vänstra sidofältets applist expanderar när pekaren flyttas över den
userProfile.showPinAppRailButton: Visa knappen för att fästa appen
userProfile.showPinAppRailButtonDesc: Visa en knapp i applist för att fästa den öppen. Av som standard.
userProfile.navigationTabsDesc: Välj vilka flikar som visas i appens list
userProfile.showSnippetCommandsDesc: Visa varje kodavsnitts kommando under dess namn. Stäng av för en kompakt lista.
userProfile.createApiKeyDescription: Generera en ny API-nyckel för programmatisk åtkomst.
userProfile.apiKeyCreatedWarning: Nyckel skapad – kopiera den nu, den visas inte igen.
userProfile.apiKeyPermissionsHint: Nycklar ärver behörigheterna från den skapande användaren.
userProfile.exportDataDesc: Ladda ner en säkerhetskopia av dina värdar, inloggningsuppgifter och inställningar för att överföra till en annan enhet.
userProfile.importDataDesc: Återställ dina värdar, inloggningsuppgifter och inställningar från en .sqlite-säkerhetskopia

userProfile.linkedProfileDescription: This device uses your account on the server and keeps a copy of your data, so it still works offline.

credentials:read.title: See your passwords and keys
credentials:read.consequence: It can read the stored secret for any host you can reach.

ssh:connect.title: Run commands on your servers
ssh:connect.consequence: Any command, on hosts you connect it to, with your access.

process:spawn.title: Run programs on this machine
process:spawn.consequence: Programs run on the Termix server itself, not on your hosts.

users:write.title: Create and change user accounts
users:write.consequence: It can add users and change their roles.

auth:provide.title: Handle sign in
auth:provide.consequence: It can add a login method, a second factor or an SSH sign-in type.

system:tls.title: Manage certificates
system:tls.consequence: It can replace the certificate Termix serves over HTTPS and answer domain checks from certificate authorities.

device:serial.title: Access serial and USB devices
device:serial.consequence: It can open a physical serial port on the machine running Termix.

hosts:write.title: Create and change hosts
hosts:write.consequence: It can add hosts and edit the ones you already have.

credentials:use.title: Connect to your servers
credentials:use.consequence: It cannot see your passwords or keys.

credentials:write.title: Save new credentials
credentials:write.consequence: It can add passwords and keys to your saved credentials.

network:outbound.title: Reach the internet
network:outbound.consequence: It can send requests to outside services.

network:serve.title: Accept connections
network:serve.consequence: It opens a port on the Termix server.

network:broadcast.title: Send network broadcasts
network:broadcast.consequence: It can send packets to devices on the local network, such as a Wake-on-LAN signal.

users:read.title: See usernames and roles
users:read.consequence: Never password hashes, never two factor state.

events:core.title: Watch everything happening
events:core.consequence: Including activity from other users, not just yours.

notify:send.title: Send alerts
notify:send.consequence: To you or other users, and through the channels they set up.

notify:hub.title: Receive every alert
notify:hub.consequence: Stores and delivers the alerts all plugins send, including their contents.

audit:read.title: Read the audit log
audit:read.consequence: It can see who did what and when.

desktop:window.title: Open desktop windows
desktop:window.consequence: Only in the Termix desktop app.

users:impersonate.title: Act as other users
users:impersonate.consequence: Runs background work with another user's access, such as scheduled jobs. Every use is written to the audit log.

db:core-refs.title: Read core account tables
db:core-refs.consequence: Can query users, roles and hosts directly from the database.

hosts:read.title: See your host list
hosts:read.consequence: Names and addresses for hosts you can already see.

db:own.title: Store its own data
db:own.consequence: Kept in its own tables, separate from other plugins.

files:own.title: Store its own files
files:own.consequence: In its own folder on disk, separate from other plugins.

secrets:own.title: Store its own secrets
secrets:own.consequence: Encrypted by Termix. The plugin never holds the key.

settings:read-core.title: Read Termix settings
settings:read-core.consequence: Server settings, not your hosts or credentials.

plugins:read.title: See installed features
plugins:read.consequence: It can see which features are installed and running.

ui:surface.title: Add its own screens
ui:surface.consequence: Tabs, panels and settings you can hide later.

runtime.disabledHint: It is turned off on this server.
runtime.missingHint: The feature it came from has been removed.
runtime.failedHint: An admin can check the server logs for details.

settings.pluginSettingsInvalid: Some settings could not be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
settings.featureUnavailable: {{name}} is unavailable right now. These settings are saved but will not take effect.

managerCard.sudoHint: Set a sudo password for this host in the host editor to enable privileged actions.

sync.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
sync.unlinkedBody: Termix works on its own on this device. Link it to your Termix server to keep everything in step.
sync.unlinkedPointHosts: Your hosts, credentials, snippets and settings follow you to every device.
sync.unlinkedPointOffline: Everything still works when the server cannot be reached, and catches up later.
sync.unlinkedPointAccount: You sign in with your server account, and hosts people shared with you show up here too.
sync.unlinked: This device is no longer linked
sync.unlinkDescription: It stops syncing and signs out of the server. Hosts shared with you by others are removed from this device either way.
sync.unlinkKeepBody: Your hosts, credentials and settings stay on this device and keep working on their own.
sync.unlinkRemoveBody: Everything that came from the server is removed from this device. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
sync.conflictsDescription: These were changed here and on the server at the same time. The server version is in use. Keep yours to send it to the server instead.
sync.errorsDescription: The server did not accept these changes. They stay on this device.
sync.errorPermission: Your account on the server is not allowed to make this change.
sync.whatSyncsDescription: Turn off anything you want to keep on this device only.
sync.notOnServer: The server does not have this
sync.localOnlyHint: You can also keep single hosts or folders on this device from their settings.
sync.originDescription: Connect to hosts from this device, or through the server. You can change this per host.

proxy.title: Reverse proxy
proxy.description: Only needed when something like Cloudflare Access or a login page sits in front of your server.
proxy.headersHint: Sent with every request to the server, for example a Cloudflare Access service token.
proxy.basicAuthHint: For a proxy that asks for a username and password before Termix.
proxy.allowInvalidCertificateHint: Only for your own server, when its certificate is not from a known authority.

problems.invalidUrl: That does not look like a web address.
problems.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that the server is running.
problems.tlsUntrusted: The server certificate is not trusted. If this is your own server with a self-signed certificate, turn on the option below.
problems.basicAuthRequired: Something in front of the server asks for a username and password. Enter them below.
problems.proxyLogin: A login page or proxy answered instead of Termix. Add the headers it needs below, or check the address.
problems.notTermix: There is no Termix server at that address. If it runs under a path, include it, like https://example.com/termix.
problems.versionMismatch: That server runs an older Termix. Update it to 2.9 or newer to link.
problems.differentAccount: You signed in to a different account. Sign in to the account this device is linked to, or unlink first.

wizard.title: Link to a Termix server
wizard.serverDescription: Enter the address you use to open Termix in your browser.
wizard.chooseDescription: This device already has data. What should happen to it?
wizard.mergeBody: The {{count}} items on this device are added to your account. Items your account already has stay as they are on the server.
wizard.replaceBody: The {{count}} items on this device are removed, and this device takes everything from your account. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
wizard.linking: Linking and running the first sync...
wizard.linked: Linked. Your data is syncing now.
wizard.signedInAgain: Signed in. Sync is running again.

hostDefaults.resetTitle: This host sets its own value. Click to use the default from {{source}} again
hostDefaults.clearTitle: Set at this level. Click to clear it and use {{source}} instead
hostDefaults.descriptionAdmin: Defaults for every host on this server. A user's own defaults, a folder's defaults or the host itself can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.descriptionUser: Defaults for all of your hosts, over the server's. A folder or the host itself can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.descriptionFolder: Defaults for the hosts in this folder and its subfolders, over your own. A host can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.savedInBackground: Defaults saved. Hosts are being updated in the background.
hostDefaults.appliedToHosts_one: {{count}} host was updated with the new defaults.
hostDefaults.appliedToHosts_other: {{count}} hosts were updated with the new defaults.
hostDefaults.confirmChanges_one: {{count}} host follows these defaults and will change.
hostDefaults.confirmChanges_other: {{count}} hosts follow these defaults and will change.
hostDefaults.confirmNoChanges: No existing host changes. New hosts will start with these defaults.
hostDefaults.adminSectionDescription: Set the defaults every host on this server follows, for every setting a host has, including each feature's. Users and folders can set their own on top, and any host can still use its own value.
